nodes.title: US releases 2025 list of critical minerals, featuring 10 additions

labels.summary: The US government released its 2025 list of 60 critical minerals, adding 10 new minerals to the previous list. These minerals are considered essential to the US economy and would cause significant economic disruption if supplies were interrupted.

nodes.title: Securing Defense Supply Chains in a Rare Earth World

labels.summary: The article discusses U.S. efforts to reduce dependence on China's rare earth monopoly through regulatory measures and allied partnerships. A comment highlights HyProMag Recycling's efficient rare earth recovery process achieving over 97% recovery rates.

nodes.title: Malaysia becomes a lynchpin in US-led effort to break China’s grip on rare earths

labels.summary: Malaysia has become a key partner in the US-led effort to establish a rare earth supply chain independent of China's dominance. The US has accelerated policies and agreements with allies including Malaysia to secure critical mineral supplies, though breaking China's grip on this market remains challenging.

nodes.title: Tech Bytes: Antimony — the obscure metal that could choke tech supply chains

labels.summary: The article discusses antimony, an obscure metal that could potentially disrupt technology supply chains. Nova Minerals Ltd shares jumped over 20% following developments related to antimony mining operations.

nodes.title: The story behind the scramble for Greenland's rare earths

labels.summary: As Western nations seek to reduce dependence on China's dominance in rare earth element production, mining companies are exploring Greenland's untapped mineral deposits. The Tanbreez project represents one of the largest potential rare earth mining operations in Greenland, amid growing geopolitical tensions over access to these critical materials.

nodes.title: Critical Metals Executes Term-Sheet for 50/50 Joint Venture With EU and NATO Member, Romania, Creating a Fully Integrated Mine-to-Processing Supply Chain for Long-Term Security for the European Manufacturing & National Security Sectors

organizations: Fabrica de Prelucrare a Concentratelor de Uraniu S.R.L.

labels.summary: Critical Metals Corp. has executed a term sheet for a 50/50 joint venture with Romania's state-owned FPCU to develop a rare earth processing facility. This partnership aims to create the first fully integrated mine-to-processing supply chain in the Western world for critical minerals, providing long-term security for European manufacturing and defense sectors.

nodes.title: Critical Metals partners with Romania's FPCU to set up rare earth processing plant

labels.summary: Critical Metals announced a joint venture with Romania's FPCU to establish a rare earth processing facility in Romania for minerals from their Tanbreez mine. The company's shares rose 4% in premarket trading following the announcement.

nodes.title: Vulcan breaks ground on German lithium, geothermal project

labels.summary: Vulcan Energy Resources Ltd has begun construction on the first phase of its geothermal and lithium extraction plant in Germany's Upper Rhine Valley. This marks a significant milestone for the company's major G-LEP project combining renewable energy generation with lithium production.
